before: One rule decided every viewport follow: a pointer press scrolled to its caret, and a shift-extended or form-fill Tab move scrolled to nothing.
after: The caller states which moves may scroll. A press does not, a move that carries the selection head follows it, and Select All stays put.
reason: The change gates a viewport scroll on the caller. The selection it publishes, the operations it produces, the snapshot and every protocol message are unchanged.
